pdf_script = '''
import fitz  # PyMuPDF
from docx import Document

# Read the docx content
doc = Document("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

# Create a new PDF
pdf = fitz.open()

# Page settings
page_width = 595  # A4 width in points
page_height = 842  # A4 height in points
margin = 50
y = margin
line_height = 14
title_height = 22
subtitle_height = 18

page = pdf.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)

for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text = para.text.strip()
    if not text:
        y += 8
        continue

    style_name = para.style.name if para.style else ""

    if "Title" in style_name or "Heading 1" in style_name:
        fontsize = 18
        fontname = "helv"
        y += 6
    elif "Heading" in style_name or "Subtitle" in style_name:
        fontsize = 14
        fontname = "helv"
        y += 4
    else:
        fontsize = 10
        fontname = "helv"

    # Check if we need a new page
    if y + fontsize + 4 > page_height - margin:
        page = pdf.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
        y = margin

    # Insert text
    text_point = fitz.Point(margin, y + fontsize)
    # Truncate long lines to fit page width
    max_chars = int((page_width - 2 * margin) / (fontsize * 0.5))
    if len(text) > max_chars:
        # Wrap text
        words = text.split()
        line = ""
        for word in words:
            test = line + " " + word if line else word
            if len(test) > max_chars:
                if line:
                    tp = fitz.Point(margin, y + fontsize)
                    page.insert_text(tp, line, fontsize=fontsize, fontname=fontname)
                    y += fontsize + 2
                    if y + fontsize + 4 > page_height - margin:
                        page = pdf.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
                        y = margin
                line = word
            else:
                line = test
        if line:
            tp = fitz.Point(margin, y + fontsize)
            page.insert_text(tp, line, fontsize=fontsize, fontname=fontname)
            y += fontsize + 4
    else:
        page.insert_text(text_point, text, fontsize=fontsize, fontname=fontname)
        y += fontsize + 4

# Also handle tables
for table in doc.tables:
    y += 8
    for row in table.rows:
        cells_text = [cell.text.strip() for cell in row.cells]
        row_text = " | ".join(cells_text)
        if y + 14 > page_height - margin:
            page = pdf.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
            y = margin
        tp = fitz.Point(margin, y + 10)
        page.insert_text(tp, row_text, fontsize=10, fontname="helv")
        y += 14

pdf.save("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
pdf.close()
print("PDF created successfully")
'''
await write_file("./create_pdf.py", pdf_script)
